reports.title: [0.1.22] Runtime bootstrap fails on Windows (WinError 206) because browser-playwright artifact dirs are created under the CWD even when no browser tool is used
reports.summary: The runtime bootstrap fails on Windows when the current working directory path exceeds the MAX_PATH limit, because Playwright artifact directories are placed under the workspace root instead of the short OPENMINION_HOME path. This occurs even when no browser tools are enabled, causing the agent setup to abort with a WinError 206. The issue blocks Windows users from running openminion in deep project directories.
reports.suggested_next_action: Assign to the tools maintainer to adjust the Playwright artifact root handling to respect OPENMINION_HOME or allow explicit configuration, and add a test for long path scenarios on Windows.
